deadline.value: The department page lists only the Autumn 2026 cycle (priority December 15, 2025); the Autumn 2027 dates are not posted.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is required of all PhD applicants (no minimum score) and cannot be waived.
gre_general.quote: We require the GRE General Test; we do not require any of the GRE Subject Tests.

also.quote: No. The GRE is required of all applicants and cannot be waived.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test is required.
gre_subject.quote: we do not require any of the GRE Subject Tests

toefl_min.value: The department requires TOEFL iBT 100 (600 paper) or equivalent, above the university minimum.
toefl_min.quote: we require at least a 600 on the paper-based TOEFL (100 on the iBT)

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to the department, not to a faculty member; advisors are chosen later (typically in year 3).
supervisor.quote: Unlike some other departments, we admit students to the statistics department to work in statistics, but not to work with a particular faculty member.

funding.value: All applicants are considered for fellowships and associateships; those offered funding at admission are typically supported up to five years, but not everyone is offered it.
funding.quote: All applicants for admission are considered for funding through the department.

also.quote: typically guaranteed funding through the duration of their program
Any international applicant who is admitted and not offered full funding must submit documents to prove that you have sufficient financial resources

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's in any subject is the minimum.
entry_route.quote: four-year baccalaureate or higher degree (in any subject area) from an accredited college or university

notes: Application deadlines for Autumn 2027 were not posted on the page checked.
